pr.title: Complete Azure provisioning SDK integration coverage
pr.author: sebastienros

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Infrastructure.Tests, Infrastructure, Infrastructure, tests/Infrastruc... / Infrastructure (ubuntu-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: Failure is in Infrastructure.Tests.Hex1bNativePublishingTests.NativeAssetsKeepTheirLayoutAndContents, which parses MSBuild JSON item output that gets truncated/corrupted intermittently. This test is unrelated to PR changes (Azure provisioning proxies) and matches prior recurring cause 'hex1bnativepublishingtests-json-parse-error' (issue #20272, previously seen with a different rid).

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.RemoteHost.Tests, Hosting.RemoteHost, Hosting.RemoteHos... / Hosting.RemoteHost (windows-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: 'Build test project' step failed with a generic exit code 1 and no job log details were retrievable ('Failed to fetch logs for job'). This matches the recurring pattern of widespread, unexplained 'Build test project' failures across unrelated jobs (prior cause 'build-test-project-widespread-exit1-unrelated', issue #19838, 17 prior occurrences), not any specific code change in this PR.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: Test 'Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone' timed out waiting for the pwa-msedge child session for the Blazor WASM root debugger. This matches the known recurring flaky pattern 'vscode-extension-e2e-unrelated-logs-unavailable' (issue #19618, 29 prior occurrences) affecting the VS Code extension Blazor browser debugger E2E tests, unrelated to this PR's Azure provisioning changes.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: Tests 'Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for hosted-global' and 'for hosted-per-page' both timed out (~299s) waiting for the Blazor WASM root debug session. This matches the known recurring flaky pattern 'vscode-extension-e2e-blazordebugger-timeout-linux' (issue #20184, 3 prior occurrences) on Linux, unrelated to this PR's Azure provisioning changes.
